knownTotals.note: Bandit, Explorer, Gambler, Herbalist, Horseman, Master Hunter, Sharpshooter, Survivalist, Weapons Expert
9 x 10 = 90; all 90 are part of 100% completion
Steam guide says 10 breeds - see disputes
single-source count; legendary fish count toward it
Explorer 1 = find a map, Explorer 2-10 = 9 treasure finds = 3 hunts x 3 stages

challenges.requirement: Hold up 5 townsfolk.
tips: The hold-ups must take place inside town limits; unarmed civilians are the easiest targets.
Robbing the pickpockets that try to rob you (random encounter) counts and costs no Honor.

challenges.requirement: Rob any 2 coaches, or return any 2 stolen coaches to the Fence.
tips: Easiest: steal a wagon/coach off the road and drive it to the wagon fence at Emerald Ranch.
Stagecoach lockboxes can be opened with a lockpick or by shooting the lock.

challenges.requirement: Rob the cash register in any 4 shops in one day.
tips: Pair towns that are close together, e.g. the shops of Valentine and Rhodes, or Valentine plus Wallace Station.
Do not load a save between the robberies or the day's count is lost.
Expect a bounty; wear a mask to reduce identification.

challenges.requirement: Rob any 3 coaches, or return any 3 stolen coaches to the Fence, in one day.
tips: Same methods as Bandit 2 - wagons around Emerald Ranch make this quick.
Do not reload a save between the three.

challenges.requirement: Amass a $250 bounty in one state.
tips: Train robberies and killing lawmen raise a bounty quickly.
Pay the bounty off at a post office afterwards.

challenges.requirement: Steal 5 horses and sell them to the Horse Fence at Clemens Cove.
tips: Any horses work; a stagecoach team can yield several horses at once.
Clemens Cove is in Lemoyne, north-east of Rhodes.
prerequisites: The Clemens Cove horse fence only opens after the Chapter 3 mission 'Horse Flesh for Dinner'.

challenges.requirement: Rob $50 worth of cash and valuables from townsfolk and travellers.
tips: Most people carry very little; well-dressed people in Saint Denis carry more.
Robbing train passengers (e.g. the train near the suspension bridge at Riggs Station) is a quick source.
Takes a while - fold it in with Bandit 10 train robberies.

challenges.requirement: Steal 7 wagons and sell them to the Fence at Emerald Ranch.
tips: Plenty of wagons travel the roads near Emerald Ranch; take one and drive it straight to the wagon fence.

challenges.requirement: Hogtie someone and leave them on the railroad tracks 3 times.
tips: The victim does not need to be hit by a train - tie, place on the tracks, and it counts.
Victims can be ordinary townsfolk or enemies; use three separate victims.

challenges.requirement: Complete 5 train robberies without dying or being caught.
tips: Minimal robbery: buy a ticket, board, rob one passenger (or loot the cargo), then get off and escape.
Dying or being caught during the robbery means it does not count.

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure map.
tips: The Explorer category effectively starts when you pick up your first treasure map.
Easiest early map: the Jack Hall Gang map from the treasure hunter Maximo near Flatneck Station (buy it, Chapter 2+).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (any treasure-hunt stage counts, including a follow-up map).
tips: Jack Hall Gang stage 1: Caliban's Seat (rock crevice reached by ledges).
prerequisites: A treasure map in your satchel.

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: Jack Hall Gang stage 2: Cotorra Springs, in the middle of a rectangle of stones near the geysers.

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: Jack Hall Gang final stage: small island at O'Creagh's Run, under a small rock (2 gold bars).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: Start the Poisonous Trail hunt: its first map is in a lockbox under the bed in Cairn Lodge in the snowy north-west (Chapter 2+). Its stages: a hillside with dead trees (map in a tree), a hilltop stone formation (map in the centre), then the cave behind the Elysian Pool waterfall (bring a lantern).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: Continue the Poisonous Trail hunt (stage 2).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: Poisonous Trail final stage: Elysian Pool waterfall cave (4 gold bars).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: High Stakes hunt: map comes from a random treasure-hunter encounter (Chapter 3+, lasso and hogtie him) or can be bought from a fence later. Stage 1: behind Cumberland Falls, reached via a log.
prerequisites: High Stakes map availability from Chapter 3 is single-source (ppx-treasure).

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: High Stakes stage 2: Barrow Lagoon, on a broken stump between rocks.

challenges.requirement: Find a treasure (next treasure-hunt stage).
tips: High Stakes final stage: rock crevice on a cliff ledge near Bacchus Station (3 gold bars).
Any three full treasure hunts (9 finds) complete Explorer 2-10; the order of hunts does not matter.

challenges.requirement: Win 5 hands of Poker.
tips: Wins do not need to be consecutive. Poker tables: Valentine, Flatneck Station, Saint Denis.
Flatneck Station has lower stakes.

challenges.requirement: In Blackjack, double down and win the hand 5 times.
tips: Double down (take exactly one more card) when your starting total is low enough that one card cannot bust you, e.g. 9-11.
Luck based; save before sitting down.

challenges.requirement: Win 3 games of Five Finger Fillet.
tips: Wins need not be consecutive. The first-round opponent at each table is easiest (only two buttons).
Tables: Valentine, Strawberry, Van Horn. If no opponent is present, rent a room and sleep.

challenges.requirement: Bust out one Poker opponent in each of Flatneck Station, Saint Denis and Valentine.
tips: You must be the one who takes the last chips of a player who went all-in.
Save before sitting down and go all-in to speed things up.

challenges.requirement: Win 3 rounds of Dominoes without drawing any tiles, against 2 or fewer opponents.
tips: Dominoes is played in Saint Denis; pick a table with only 1-2 opponents.
Play doubles early; outcome is largely random.

challenges.requirement: Beat the Blackjack dealer in Rhodes and in Van Horn.
tips: One winning hand at each location is enough.

challenges.requirement: Beat the Five Finger Fillet player in every location (Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn).
tips: Beat the easy first-round opponent at each of the three tables.

challenges.requirement: Win 3 hands of Blackjack with three hits or more.
tips: Pure luck: bet the minimum, keep hitting small cards and save after each qualifying win.
Can take anywhere from minutes to hours.

challenges.requirement: Win 3 games of Dominoes in a row.
tips: Play the All Fives variant in Saint Denis.
Getting up from the table between games resets the streak.

challenges.requirement: Win 3 hands of Poker in a row.
tips: Aggressive large bets/all-ins make opponents fold quickly.
Standing up from the table resets the streak; save before sitting.

challenges.requirement: Pick 6 Yarrow.
tips: Common across New Hanover, e.g. south of Valentine (red flower).

challenges.requirement: Pick and eat 4 species of berry.
tips: Accepted berries: Blackberry, Red Raspberry, Evergreen Huckleberry, Wintergreen Berry.
Wintergreen berry grows north-west of Annesburg, near the Old Tomb west of Deer Cottage; the plant is small.

challenges.requirement: Craft 7 items using Sage as an ingredient.
tips: Hummingbird Sage counts (Oleander Sage does not).
Recipes: Potent Bitters (Sage + Burdock Root) or Potent Horse Stimulant (Sage + Common Bulrush); no pamphlet needed.

challenges.requirement: Pick 5 mushrooms and feed them to your horse.
tips: Any mushroom species; Parasol or Bay Bolete are common.

challenges.requirement: Craft 9 items using Indian Tobacco as an ingredient.
tips: Potent Snake Oil uses Indian Tobacco; no pamphlet needed.

challenges.requirement: Pick 15 different species of herb.
tips: Only plants picked after the challenge is active count - earlier picks are not retroactive.
Species-rich areas: Black Bone Forest, Cumberland Forest, the Saint Denis bayou.

challenges.requirement: Craft and use 5 Special Miracle Tonics.
tips: Each tonic needs 6 Yarrow, 6 Burdock Root and 6 Black or Golden Currant (30 of each for all 5).
A larger satchel helps carry the ingredients.
prerequisites: The Special Miracle Tonic recipe must be bought from a Fence (GamerGuides: available after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town') - single-source detail.

challenges.requirement: Use Oleander to craft 6 poison weapons.
tips: Poison Throwing Knife = 1 throwing knife + 1 Oleander Sage (needs the pamphlet from a Fence).
Oleander Sage grows in the swamps around Saint Denis and Rhodes.
prerequisites: Throwing knives (steam: after Chapter 2 'Paying a Social Call').

challenges.requirement: Pick one of each species of herb (43 species).
tips: Picking must happen after the challenge unlocks; earlier picks and looting from corpses do not count.
Several plants (e.g. Desert Sage, Red Sage, Wild Feverfew, Blackcurrant) grow only in New Austin, so plan this for the Epilogue.
Orchids count; Algernon Wasp's orchid missions can temporarily turn orchids you still owe him into ordinary flowers.

challenges.requirement: Season and cook all 11 types of meat.
tips: Season with Creeping Thyme, Oregano or Wild Mint at a campfire.
Meats: Big Game, Crustacean, Exotic Bird, Flaky Fish, Game, Mutton, Plump Bird, Pork, Prime Beef, Succulent Fish, Venison.
Pork, Prime Beef and Venison can be bought from a butcher.

challenges.requirement: Kill 5 rabbits from horseback.
tips: Rabbits are common south of Valentine and around Flatneck Station.

challenges.requirement: Jump over 3 obstacles in 15 seconds.
tips: Fences or small rocks; jumping the same obstacle back and forth works.

challenges.requirement: Ride from Valentine to Rhodes in less than 5 minutes.
tips: Follow the railroad tracks; do not fall off.
Horse Stimulant (stables) or calming the horse restores stamina.

challenges.requirement: While mounted, drag a victim for 3300 feet (about 1 km) using your lasso.
tips: Must start with a living person (townsfolk are fine); they may die during the drag.
Dismounting or losing the rope resets progress; corpses and animals do not count.

challenges.requirement: Trample 5 animals while on horseback.
tips: Slow animals like pheasants, turkeys, ducks, frogs; the area south of Rhodes works well.

challenges.requirement: Ride from Strawberry to Saint Denis in less than 9 minutes without touching any water.
tips: Puddles count as water. Follow the train tracks and cross the rail bridge south-east into Saint Denis.
Use a fast horse plus stimulants; falling off fails the run.

challenges.requirement: Kill 7 enemies from horseback without dismounting.
tips: Hostile (red) targets only; lawmen count, unarmed civilians do not.
Story missions with horseback shootouts or gang hideouts work.

challenges.requirement: Kill 9 predators from horseback.
tips: Alligators in the Lemoyne bayou/swamps (e.g. east of Shady Belle, around Saint Denis) are the fastest option; use Dead Eye.
Wolves, coyotes, cougars, and even crows/vultures count as predators per one guide.

challenges.requirement: Ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in less than 17 minutes without touching any water.
tips: Route: rail bridges past Van Horn and Flatneck, then cross the Owanjila Dam and head south to Blackwater.
Uncover the map first and carry horse stimulants.
prerequisites: PowerPyx: only possible in the Epilogue because Arthur is shot on sight at Blackwater (disputed - see disputes).

challenges.requirement: Break every wild horse breed.
tips: Required (9): American Standardbred, American Paint, Appaloosa, Hungarian Halfbred, Kentucky Saddler, Morgan, Mustang, Nokota, Tennessee Walker.
Not required: Arabian (incl. White Arabian), Thoroughbred, Andalusian, Tiger-Striped Mustang.
Several spawns are in New Austin or around Blackwater, which are practical only in the Epilogue.

challenges.requirement: Skin 3 deer.
tips: Deer are common around the early camps and Valentine.

challenges.requirement: Collect 3 perfect quality rabbit pelts.
tips: Study the rabbit to confirm 3 stars, then headshot with the Varmint Rifle or a small game arrow.
Trampled or wrong-weapon kills ruin the pelt.

challenges.requirement: Track 10 different animal species using your binoculars.
tips: Use the track option while looking through binoculars; horses, domestic animals and flying birds do not count (steam).

challenges.requirement: Call an animal and get a clean kill 5 times.
tips: Aim, use the animal call, and kill in one shot before it moves; more than one shot disqualifies.

challenges.requirement: Skin 3 black or grizzly bears.
tips: A grizzly reliably spawns west/north-west of Wallace Station; any kill method is fine.

challenges.requirement: Kill 5 cougars with your bow, then skin them.
tips: Considered the hardest Master Hunter task. Cougars roam West Elizabeth near the trapper and the northern mountains.
Poison arrows remove the need for headshots; stay mounted for escape and save often.

challenges.requirement: Use bait to lure and kill both a herbivore and a predator.
tips: Buy or craft herbivore and predator bait; place it away from roads and wait at a distance. Bait only attracts animals already nearby.

challenges.requirement: Catch 3 fish without using a fishing rod.
tips: Shoot fish with small-calibre weapons or a bow, trample them in shallow water, or chase them onto the bank.
Dynamite destroys the fish so they cannot be picked up (PowerPyx).

challenges.requirement: Catch an opossum playing possum.
tips: Opossums spawn at night, e.g. near Riggs Station or across the tracks east of the first camp.
Chase it until it falls over faking death, then pick it up (safest) - sources differ on whether killing it also works.

challenges.requirement: Find and kill the legendary panther 'Giaguaro'.
tips: Lives in Scarlett Meadows, Lemoyne - east of Braithwaite Manor / south of Bolger Glade, towards Shady Belle.
Unlike other legendaries it stalks you after you study its tracks; very high health, bring a strong rifle and Dead Eye.
prerequisites: Giaguaro only spawns after Master Hunter 9 is complete.

challenges.requirement: Kill 3 flying birds.
tips: Any birds in flight.

challenges.requirement: Kill 2 different species of animal in the same Dead Eye use.
tips: Mixed duck flocks on rivers usually contain two species.

challenges.requirement: Kill 5 flying birds while on a moving train.
tips: Buy a ticket and shoot from the rear platform; jump off afterwards if you draw a bounty.

challenges.requirement: Kill someone at least 80 feet away with a tomahawk.
tips: People only, not animals. The reticle turns red when the target is in throwing range.
prerequisites: Tomahawks (buyable at fence/trapper after an early Chapter 2 mission - see disputes).

challenges.requirement: Kill 6 animals without switching or reloading your weapon.
tips: Duck flocks along rivers with a repeater.

challenges.requirement: Kill someone at least 660 feet away with a long scoped rifle.
tips: Needs a rifle fitted with a long scope (Bolt Action, Carcano, etc.).
Elevated positions help, e.g. the Hanging Dog Ranch hideout.

challenges.requirement: Get 7 headshots in a row.
tips: People or animals count; a missed or non-lethal headshot breaks the streak.

challenges.requirement: Disarm 3 enemies without reloading or switching your weapon.
tips: Shoot enemies' hands/weapons; Dead Eye tagging hands on 3 enemies works. Use a high-capacity gun.

challenges.requirement: Shoot 3 people's hats off in the same Dead Eye use.
tips: Mark the hats in Dead Eye; one guide suggests a buckshot shotgun aimed just above heads from medium range.

challenges.requirement: Kill 3 flying birds with 3 consecutive long scoped rifle shots.
tips: Any miss resets. You may leave and re-enter the scope between shots.

challenges.requirement: Catch 3 Bluegill.
tips: Common in rivers, lakes and swamps; cheese bait works.

challenges.requirement: Hand in 5 animals to camp or a trapper.
tips: Any animal, bird or fish donated to Pearson or sold to a trapper counts.

challenges.requirement: Kill 5 animals with a Varmint Rifle.
tips: Any small animals, birds or fish.

challenges.requirement: Craft a dynamite, fire, improved, poison, and small game arrow.
tips: Improved, fire and small game arrows are available from Chapter 2; dynamite and poison arrows need pamphlets from a Fence.

challenges.requirement: Catch a fish in the Bayou from a boat (PowerPyx wording: riverboat; any small boat such as a rowboat works) and while standing on train tracks.
tips: Bayou = the swamps around Saint Denis. Boats sit at piers such as Caliga Hall or Lagras.
The train-track catch must also be in the Bayou region.

challenges.requirement: Kill a scavenging animal while it is feeding on a corpse, 5 times.
tips: Leave a carcass and kill the scavenger while it is eating; predator bait also counts as a corpse.

challenges.requirement: Kill 8 small game animals with consecutive shots, using small game arrows.
tips: One arrow per kill; a miss, a second shot or a too-large animal (e.g. rabbit) resets.
Rats/bats in the Elysian Pool cave or birds on rocks are good targets.

challenges.requirement: Craft a homing tomahawk, improved tomahawk, volatile dynamite, and volatile fire bottle.
tips: All four need pamphlets sold by the Fence (stock depends on story progress); ingredients include moonshine, animal fat and bird feathers.

challenges.requirement: Catch a fish that weighs at least 19 lb.
tips: Muskie (e.g. Lake Isabella), Lake Sturgeon, Northern Pike, Longnose Gar (behind Shady Belle) or Channel Catfish; legendary fish count.

challenges.requirement: Catch one of each type of fish (15 species).
tips: Small species appear in any suitable water; large species have specific spots. Legendary fish count.

challenges.requirement: Kill 3 enemies with a knife.
tips: Often completes naturally in stealth story missions or at bandit camps.

challenges.requirement: Kill 3 enemies in 10 seconds using only throwing knives.
tips: Use Dead Eye; gang hideouts or story missions work.
prerequisites: Throwing knives (steam: after Chapter 2 'Paying a Social Call').

challenges.requirement: Kill 3 birds of prey using only a tomahawk.
tips: Leave a carcass to attract vultures/crows; eagles and hawks land on rocks and rail bridges. Use Eagle Eye to spot them.

challenges.requirement: Kill 10 enemies with a shotgun using crafted ammo.
tips: Craft Incendiary Buckshot (moonshine + shells) or Explosive Slugs (animal fat + slugs) - pamphlets from the Fence.

challenges.requirement: Kill 5 mounted enemies, using 1 throwing knife per kill.
tips: Headshots or poisoned knives; bounty hunters and mounted lawmen are good targets.

challenges.requirement: Kill 4 enemies at the same time with a single stick of dynamite.
tips: Hogtie enemies and pile them together, or use volatile dynamite on a gang camp.

challenges.requirement: Kill 4 consecutive enemies by throwing and retrieving the same tomahawk.
tips: Throw once into the ground and pick it up before starting; carry only one tomahawk type.
Firing any other weapon or a non-tomahawk kill resets.

challenges.requirement: Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled sidearm.
tips: Fit a long barrel to a revolver/pistol at a gunsmith (e.g. Volcanic Pistol); kills need not be consecutive.
Gang hideouts such as Hanging Dog Ranch supply enough enemies.

challenges.requirement: Kill 9 unaware enemies from behind, using the bow.
tips: Stealth at hideouts/bandit camps; retreat until the alert clears, then repeat.

challenges.requirement: Kill a grizzly bear without taking damage, using only throwing knives.
tips: Grizzlies roam north-west of Wallace Station (black bears do not count).
Use poisoned or improved throwing knives and Dead Eye headshots.

notes: Challenges are in Pause Menu > Progress > Challenges. There are 9 categories of 10 = 90 (sources: ppx, steam, ppx-trophy).
Within each category the tasks are strictly sequential: the next one unlocks only when the previous is complete (sources: ppx, steam).
Progress made before a challenge is unlocked does not count (e.g. herbs picked earlier are not retroactive for Herbalist 6 and 9) (sources: ppx, steam).
No challenge is permanently missable; all can be finished in the Epilogue (sources: ppx, steam).

Trophy link: all 90 challenges are required for 100% completion, which awards the gold trophy 'Best in the West' (Attain 100% completion). There is no separate trophy only for challenges (sources: ppx-trophy, ppx).
Challenges can be progressed in free roam, during story missions and in mission replays; abandoning a replay discards progress made in it (sources: steam).
Completing challenges awards gear (holsters, belts, bandoliers) plus attribute XP/cash per tier (sources: gg-explorer, rdr2org-weapons, rdr2org-horseman).

Explorer: Explorer 1 is picking up any treasure map; Explorer 2-10 each count one treasure find (intermediate maps count). The Jack Hall Gang, Poisonous Trail and High Stakes hunts together give exactly 9 finds (sources: ppx, steam, rdr2org-explorer, gg-explorer, ppx-treasure).
Jack Hall Gang map: buy from the treasure hunter Maximo on a ridge by the river north-west of Flatneck Station, Chapter 2 (sources: ppx-treasure, rdr2org-explorer).

Gambler venues per sources: Poker - Valentine, Flatneck Station, Saint Denis; Blackjack - Rhodes, Van Horn (gg-gambler also lists Saint Denis and Blackwater); Dominoes - Saint Denis; Five Finger Fillet - Valentine, Strawberry, Van Horn (sources: ppx, steam, gg-gambler).
Steam guide estimates 83/90 challenges possible in Chapter 2 and 88/90 in Chapter 3 (sources: steam).

disputes.details: PowerPyx's page lists the requirement as a long-barrelled shotgun; the others say sidearm.

positions.claim: Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled shotgun
Kill 15 enemies using a long-barrelled sidearm (revolver/pistol)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Use 'long-barrelled sidearm' (majority wording, matches the in-game text quoted in video titles). Tell players to fit a long barrel to a revolver or pistol.

disputes.details: Most sources list 9 required breeds; the Steam guide says 10.

positions.claim: 9 breeds (Arabian, Thoroughbred, Andalusian, Tiger-Striped Mustang not needed)

disputes.suggestedHandling: List the 9 breeds and tell players to watch the in-game checklist under the challenge for any remaining breed.

disputes.details: PowerPyx says Van Horn to Blackwater is only doable in the Epilogue because Arthur is shot on sight near Blackwater. Fandom (via search summary) says every challenge except Herbalist 9 is possible as Arthur. The Steam guide mentions lawmen near Blackwater but does not rule it out.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Recommend doing Horseman 9 in the Epilogue. Arthur may be able to finish it, but it is risky.

disputes.topic: Master Hunter 9 - kill or capture the opossum
disputes.details: Sources differ on the final action once the opossum plays dead.

positions.claim: Shoot it while it is playing dead
Pick it up while it plays dead

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to chase it until it plays dead and then pick it up. If that fails, shooting it is the fallback.

disputes.details: The sources name different Chapter 2 missions for when tomahawks can be bought.

positions.claim: After 'Americans at Rest' (or found early at Six Point Cabin)

disputes.suggestedHandling: Say tomahawks become available during Chapter 2 and check the Fence or trapper stock. Do not name a mission.

disputes.details: PowerPyx/Steam only need Rhodes and Van Horn for Gambler 6. GamerGuides also lists Saint Denis and Blackwater for blackjack, and no other source confirms those.

positions.claim: Blackjack at Rhodes and Van Horn

disputes.suggestedHandling: Tell players to use Rhodes and Van Horn only.

disputes.details: Only GamerGuides says the Special Miracle Tonic recipe must be bought from a Fence after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'. PowerPyx and Steam give no prerequisite.

positions.claim: Recipe bought from Fence after 'A Short Walk in a Pretty Town'

disputes.suggestedHandling: Mention that the recipe may need to be bought from a Fence (single source).

disputes.details: PowerPyx's treasure page notes the Poisonous Trail finale (Elysian Pool cave) is epilogue-accessible but does not clearly say whether it is reachable earlier. No source lists any Explorer challenge as epilogue-only.
disputes.suggestedHandling: Do not mark Explorer as epilogue-only. The High Stakes map needs Chapter 3+.
